items.title: Google Chrome Emergency Security Update Patches Three High-Severity Vulnerabilities
items.description: Google has released a critical security update for its Chrome browser, pushing version 145.0.7632.116/117 to Windows and macOS users, while Linux users receive version 144.0.7559.116. The update, which is rolling out progressively over the coming days and weeks, addresses three high-severity vulnerabilities that could expose users to significant risk if left unpatched.
